methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series C → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.7x) to $305M total raised proxy.

private.name: ICON
private.rationale: Same sector (Housing & Construction), same stage (Series C)

data.narrative:
Meter is a Series C-stage company in the Housing & Construction sector that has raised $305M to date. The comparable universe is sparse, consisting of one identified private peer (ICON) and no public comparables, which limits the robustness of traditional multiples-based approaches.

Given the limited comp availability, a stage-progression methodology was applied as the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($305M) as a proxy for implied pre-money value, a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C to later-stage transitions yields an implied valuation of $518M. This single-method approach generates a triangulated range of $441M to $596M, with $518M as the median, derived by applying conservative and optimistic variance bands around the stage-progression result.

The valuation range of $441M–$596M should be interpreted with caution. The analysis rests on a single methodology and an extremely limited peer set. Material uncertainty remains around comparable company multiples, unit economics, growth trajectory, and competitive positioning within Housing & Construction. A more robust valuation would require either expanded private comp data or public market benchmarking. The current analysis provides a directional midpoint but should be validated through detailed operational and financial diligence before investment decision-making.
